tools.name: groove_list_conversations
tools.description: List support conversations (tickets) in the shared inbox, with rich filters. Filter by state, channel_id, folder_id, tag_name, assigned, starred, or keywords; paginate with first/after. Groove GraphQL: conversations(filter: ConversationFilter).

tools.name: groove_get_conversation
tools.description: Get a single conversation by id — subject, state, assignment, contact, channel, counts, and tags. Groove GraphQL: conversation(id: ID!).

tools.name: groove_list_contacts
tools.description: List customer contacts (people who wrote in). Optional keyword search over name/email; paginate with first/after. Groove GraphQL: contacts(keywords: String).

tools.name: groove_get_contact
tools.description: Get a single contact by id — name, email, role, type, and conversation count. Groove GraphQL: contact(contactId: ID!).

tools.name: groove_list_agents
tools.description: List agents (support staff / users) in the account, with role and state. Paginate with first/after. Groove GraphQL: agents.

tools.name: groove_list_channels
tools.description: List channels (mailboxes / inboxes — email, chat, etc.) configured in the account. Paginate with first/after. Groove GraphQL: channels.

tools.name: groove_list_tags
tools.description: List tags defined in the account (id, name, color) — use tag ids with the tag/untag write tools. Paginate with first/after. Groove GraphQL: tags.

tools.name: groove_list_folders
tools.description: List folders (saved views / smart folders that group conversations), with conversation counts. Paginate with first/after. Groove GraphQL: folders.

tools.name: groove_list_teams
tools.description: List teams (groups of agents that conversations can be assigned to). Paginate with first/after. Groove GraphQL: teams.

tools.name: groove_close_conversation
tools.description: CLOSES a conversation (marks it resolved) in the shared inbox. Groove GraphQL: conversationClose.

tools.name: groove_open_conversation
tools.description: RE-OPENS a closed/snoozed conversation in the shared inbox. Groove GraphQL: conversationOpen.

tools.name: groove_snooze_conversation
tools.description: SNOOZES a conversation until the given time (ISO8601) — it drops out of the inbox until then. Groove GraphQL: conversationSnooze.

tools.name: groove_star_conversation
tools.description: STARS a conversation (flags it for attention) in the shared inbox. Groove GraphQL: conversationStar.

tools.name: groove_assign_conversation
tools.description: ASSIGNS a conversation to an agent and/or team. Pass agent_id, team_id, or both (at least one is required). Groove GraphQL: conversationAssign.

tools.name: groove_tag_conversation
tools.description: ADDS tags (by tag id) to a conversation. Use groove_list_tags to find tag ids. Groove GraphQL: conversationTag.

tools.name: groove_untag_conversation
tools.description: REMOVES tags (by tag id) from a conversation. Use groove_list_tags to find tag ids. Groove GraphQL: conversationUntag.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: groove_list_conversations, groove_list_contacts, groove_get_contact, groove_list_channels, groove_open_conversation · Private data: groove_get_conversation, groove_list_contacts, groove_get_contact · Public sink: groove_list_contacts, groove_get_contact, groove_list_channels.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: groove_list_conversations, groove_list_contacts, groove_get_contact, groove_list_channels, groove_open_conversation · Private data: groove_get_conversation, groove_list_contacts, groove_get_contact · Public sink: groove_list_contacts, groove_get_contact, groove_list_channels

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
